# Token Range

> iPhone and Mac app showing live rate limits for AI coding tools (Claude Code,
> Codex, Cursor, Grok, Antigravity) in the app, in the Mac menu bar, on iPhone
> Home Screen widgets, and on the iPhone Lock Screen.
> Credentials stay in the device Keychain and are sent only to the provider
> over HTTPS. There is no Token Range server, no analytics, and no account.

Key facts:
- Platforms: iOS 17 or later (iPhone) and macOS 13 or later.
- Supported tools at launch: Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Grok,
  Antigravity. More planned.
- Pricing: one connected account and every widget free forever; Lifetime Pro is a one-time
  purchase (additional accounts and 16 themes). Apple displays the current
  local price. No subscription.
- Privacy: on-device only. Keychain-stored credentials, HTTPS to providers,
  no first-party server, no tracking.
- Shows: session windows, weekly caps, percent remaining, reset countdowns,
  pace alerts before a limit runs out.

## Pages
- [Home](https://tokenrange.app/): product overview, live-limit demo, FAQ.
- [Privacy](https://tokenrange.app/privacy/): on-device data handling,
  Keychain credentials, provider connections, purchases, and deletion steps.
- [Terms](https://tokenrange.app/terms/): provider-account responsibilities,
  accuracy, Lifetime Pro, acceptable use, and liability.
- [Support](https://tokenrange.app/support/): connection help, widget freshness,
  purchase restore, data removal, refunds, and human support.
